verdict.rationale: Pipedrive documents a self-serve 14-day trial with no credit card and a core pipeline-tracking product, and a community user describes it as having 'the ease of use of Trello', which points to quick setup without a partner. Nothing in the evidence documents importing or migrating real data into that pipeline; the API is only a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented CSV/spreadsheet import or migration tooling, evidence that setup takes under an hour, a guided onboarding flow, and independent hands-on reports of self-serve time-to-value.

support.subject: As a founder, I can go from signup to a working pipeline with my real data in under an hour, without an implementation partner

citations.quote: 14-day free trial, no credit card required
Pipedrive lets you track your sales pipeline
it merges the functionality of CRM with the ease of use of Trello.
